prospective_screen_contract.cohort: All12 already-exposed cases, original ascending order; no case replacement or fresh confirmation opening.
prospective_screen_contract.fixed_pool: Reuse only exact sealed r2 directory stage outputs and legitimate source-availability state, not its file choices or scores. Both reference-file screen arms use the same historical observed ledger. This is a fixed-pool ablation, not a fresh full-policy campaign.
prospective_screen_contract.generator_input: Original issue plus exact frozen source-card packet only. No Gold, patches, hidden reasoning, old file-choice results, scores, live environment data or credentials.
prospective_screen_contract.generator_output: Strict JSON file_ids array containing zero to three exact listed IDs. Unknown IDs, duplicated IDs, extra fields or fenced JSON are invalid without repair or retry.
prospective_screen_contract.cost_posture: Add all new chooser usage to54873 sealed upstream directory-generation tokens for policy cost. Do not double-charge them as new provider dispatches or pretend cached upstream calls were free. The prior r2 file stage is not part of this new policy.
prospective_screen_contract.control: Same original-issue unexpanded source-ranker control outside the same observed state, preserved from query-expansion r1. Not a native-engine or contemporaneous DSH comparator.
prospective_screen_contract.label_barrier: Seal and verify all12 choices/source identities before first isolated exposed Gold load. Keep all36 allocated slots, missing references, empty choices and invalid outputs in the denominator.
prospective_screen_contract.claim_ceiling: Exposed file-acquisition proxy only, not useful spans, native F1 or superiority.
prospective_screen_contract.native_requirement: Any later live policy must regenerate its own directory stage and cards from its own contemporaneous observation ledger, with all localization calls inside the same total native budget. Qualification still requires a new native matched campaign and untouched confirmation.
